projects.name: MockMate-AI – Personalized Interviewer
projects.description: Developed a web application that helps candidates practice for their interviews in a realistic and conversational tone.
highlights: Implemented a chat-based system using Google Gemini API, where the AI conducts interviews, asks questions, and provides a performance score at the end.
Deployed a live, login-based web application that simulates realistic interview sessions.

projects.name: FixMyCity – AI-Powered Civic Issue Reporting Platform
projects.description: Designed and developed a scalable full-stack civic issue reporting platform using Next.js and Google Gemini API.
highlights: Implemented secure authentication, role-based authorization and real-time complaint tracking with relational database integration.

projects.name: EmotionSense – Real-Time Facial Emotion Recognition
projects.description: Developed a CNN-based facial emotion recognition system to classify emotions with 83% accuracy.
highlights: Built an end-to-end computer vision pipeline using OpenCV and TensorFlow for real-time facial emotion recognition.
